description: A composite schematic (no axes, no scale bars, no numerical data) illustrating ordered precipitates in duplex low-density steels. The large background panel, headed "Micro-scale", shows a red austenite (γ) grain field separated by black grain boundaries and crossed diagonally by two light-blue bands: the wider one is labelled "B2 Stringer band @ 700 °C and 500 °C", the narrower one "α + B2(nano)". Black elongated particles lying in the red matrix are indicated by an arrow labelled "B2"; an arrow marks a boundary feature labelled "GB B2"; the text "γ + κ(nano) + B2(micro)" is printed inside a red grain. Two circular "Nano-scale" insets zoom into the phases: the lower-left red inset contains grey rectangular blocks labelled "κ", annotated "nano-sized κ in γ Matrix"; the lower-right blue inset contains grey rounded discs/ellipsoids labelled "B2", annotated "nano-sized B2 in α Matrix". The group makes one argument: B2 exists at two length scales — micron-sized particles and grain-boundary precipitates in γ, plus nano-sized discs in α-ferrite — whereas κ-carbide appears as nano-sized blocks in γ.
measured_quantities: annealing temperature (°C) — shown only as label text '700 °C and 500 °C', no plotted values

observations.observation: The main panel is headed 'Micro-scale' and depicts a red austenite (γ) grain field with black grain boundaries traversed by two light-blue bands.
The wider blue band in the main panel is labelled 'B2 Stringer band @ 700 °C and 500 °C'.
The narrower blue band is labelled 'α + B2(nano)'.
The red matrix of the micro-scale panel carries the annotation 'γ + κ(nano) + B2(micro)', i.e. nano-sized κ and micron-sized B2 coexist in the austenite matrix.
An arrow labelled 'GB B2' points to a precipitate located on a γ grain boundary, indicating grain-boundary B2 precipitates.
A separate arrow labelled 'B2' points to a black elongated particle inside the red matrix, representing micron-sized B2 particles.
The lower-left circular 'Nano-scale' inset (red) shows grey rectangular blocks labelled 'κ' with the annotation 'nano-sized κ in γ Matrix'.
The lower-right circular 'Nano-scale' inset (blue) shows grey rounded disc/ellipsoid particles labelled 'B2' with the annotation 'nano-sized B2 in α Matrix'.
The two inset panels contrast precipitate morphology: κ-carbide as blocky/rectangular shapes and B2 as rounded discs, in γ and α matrices respectively.
No axes, scale bars, numeric values or colour-bar scales appear anywhere in the figure; all content is schematic.
The caption states the figure is a schematic representation of ordered precipitates observed in the microstructures of the steels under study.
The citing text states that B2 formed as micron-sized particles and grain-boundary precipitates in the austenite phase and as nano-sized discs in the ferrite (the blue circle of Fig. 1).
The citing text states that the discs were of Ni-Al type in the Ni-containing samples but of Fe-Al type in Ni-free samples.

The citing text states that at 500-700 °C κ-carbides formed nano-sized blocks in the austenite of both Ni-containing and Ni-free samples and micron-sized needles within the ferrite only in the Ni-free sample (the red circle of Fig. 1).

The citing text states that at low annealing temperature between 500 and 700 °C the ferrite phase in the 5% Ni sample was replaced by B2 stringer bands, matching the 'B2 Stringer band' label in the schematic.

subfigures.description: Large schematic of the micro-scale structure: a red austenite (γ) grain field with black grain boundaries, crossed by two light-blue bands labelled 'B2 Stringer band @ 700 °C and 500 °C' and 'α + B2(nano)'. Black elongated B2 particles sit in the red matrix (arrow 'B2'), a grain-boundary precipitate is arrowed 'GB B2', and the matrix is annotated 'γ + κ(nano) + B2(micro)'.
Circular red 'Nano-scale' inset showing grey rectangular/blocky precipitates labelled 'κ' dispersed in the red γ matrix, annotated 'nano-sized κ in γ Matrix'.
Circular blue 'Nano-scale' inset showing grey rounded disc/ellipsoid precipitates labelled 'B2' in the blue α matrix, annotated 'nano-sized B2 in α Matrix'.
